flags.name: Red Long
flags.issue: NAME — truncated/mis-derived. Every FFT invoice line for code SBCH reads 'Shallot', sold per Bunch at $1.65-$3.41 (17 invoices, INB00099947 to INB00113602). 'Red Long' looks lifted from a neighbouring 'Chilli Red Long' line.
flags.suggested_fix: CONFIRMED from supplier invoices: map SBCH -> 'Shallot' (per bunch). Matches the existing Lightspeed 'Shallot [Bunch]' at $1.93/bunch.

flags.name: Tomatoes Roma half box please
flags.issue: NAME — leaked order words. 'half box please' is an ordering note, not part of the product. The junk is in FFT's own invoice text (INB00105997: 'Tomatoes Roma half box please', 0.5 Box @ $37.40).
flags.suggested_fix: CONFIRMED: name -> 'Tomatoes Roma', pack 1 box @ $37.40. Strip trailing order phrases (please / half box / thanks) from FFT descriptions.

flags.name: (Sub 18120) Instant
flags.issue: NAME — substitution placeholder, not a product. Six of seven B&E invoices for code 15379 read 'INSTANT NOODLE - 10 PCS/PK' (1 CTN @ $14.90); only the newest (6889760, 2026-07-01) says '(SUB 18120) INSTANT', and the newest is what got picked up. This is also why pack_qty/pack_unit/cost_per_base_unit are all null.
flags.suggested_fix: CONFIRMED from the earlier invoices: name -> 'Instant Noodle - 10 pcs/pk', pack 1 ctn (10 pcs) @ $14.90. Prefer the modal description across invoices over the newest when the newest carries a '(Sub NNNNN)' prefix.

flags.name: Floor Cleaner 20ltr
flags.issue: CATEGORY — a cleaning chemical in the recipe ingredient database. $38.50 per 20L (SI4408342, SI4357077 'FLOOR CLEANER 20LTR Reliance'). Not something a chef cooks with; it should not be costable into a dish.
flags.suggested_fix: Exclude from the chef's ingredient picker (cleaning / chemical / packaging class). Keep the purchase for COGS and Xero, just not as a food ingredient.

flags.name: Beans Edamame Soy Frozen [350g]
flags.issue: COST — 2.4x the supplier's own price. Cost book has $0.025714/g = $25.71/kg = $9.00 per 350g pack. Foodlink invoices the same 350g frozen edamame (code 100180) at $3.80 = $10.86/kg.
flags.suggested_fix: Re-cost from the Foodlink invoice: $3.80 per 350g pack ($0.010857/g). Confirm which pack the cost book was priced against before overwriting.

flags.name: Choi Sum [bunch]
flags.issue: COST — $9.00 per bunch is implausible for choi sum. Every other bunch line sits at $1.10-$2.65 (Shallot $1.93, chives $1.70, FFT Herb Mint $1.10). Smells like a carton/box price sitting in a per-bunch field.
flags.suggested_fix: COULD NOT CONFIRM — no invoice line for this item (cost book only, last_seen 2026-01-02). Needs Zak or the chef to state whether $9.00 is a bunch or a box.

flags.name: Sweet Chilli Jam Knorr [920g]
flags.issue: COST — $0.057609/g = $57.61/kg = $53.00 for a 920g jar. Knorr sweet chilli jam trades well below that; looks like a 6-jar case cost divided by one jar's weight.
flags.suggested_fix: COULD NOT CONFIRM — cost book only, no invoice. Check the case configuration; if it is 6x920g the per-jar cost is about $8.83 and per-kg about $9.60.

flags.name: Onion Brown [kg]
flags.issue: PACK — the name says [kg] but pack_unit came through as 'can' (1 can @ $1.54). The $1.54 is a per-kilo price wearing the wrong unit, so anything costing a weight of brown onion reads it wrong.
flags.suggested_fix: pack_unit -> kg, cost_per_base_unit -> $0.00154/g ($1.54/kg). Part of the cost-book 'can' defaulting below.

flags.name: Potato Peeled [kg]
flags.issue: PACK — same as Onion Brown: name says [kg], pack_unit is 'can' (1 can @ $3.60).
flags.suggested_fix: pack_unit -> kg, cost_per_base_unit -> $0.0036/g ($3.60/kg).

flags.name: Ponzu Dashi Vinegar Uchibori [360mL]
flags.issue: PACK — name says [360mL], pack_unit is 'can'. The value $0.0153 is clearly per mL ($5.51 for 360mL), so the number is right and the unit is wrong.
flags.suggested_fix: pack_unit -> ml, pack_qty -> 360.

flags.name: Archie Rose Signature Gin
flags.issue: PACK — a spirit priced as '1 can @ $62.08' while every other spirit in this batch is per mL. $62.08 is a bottle cost, so any cocktail recipe pouring 30mL of it cannot cost correctly.
flags.suggested_fix: pack_unit -> ml, pack_qty -> 700, cost_per_base_unit -> about $0.0887/ml. Confirm the bottle size (700mL assumed).

flags.name: BBQ Pork Buns Canton [ea]; Barebones Clear Ice Block; Cauliflower [ea]; Egg Fresh [ea]; Lemonade [mixer]; Pink Lemonade [mixer]; Peking Duck Spring Rolls Canton [ea]; Spring Roll Veg Hakka [ea]; Turkish Bread [ea]
flags.issue: PACK (systemic) — pack_unit defaults to 'can' whenever the cost book's pack string cannot be parsed. 17 of the 123 cost-book products came through as 'can', including six clearly marked [ea] and the [kg]/[mL]/spirit cases flagged separately above. 'can' is not a neutral fallback: it silently asserts a pack the product does not have.
flags.suggested_fix: Do not default to 'can'. Parse the unit out of the trailing [ea] / [kg] / [bunch] / [NNNg] / [NNNmL] tag in the name, and where nothing parses set needs_pack_review=true so the chef is asked instead of being given a wrong unit.

flags.name: Shiitake Mushrooms Dried
flags.issue: DUPLICATE — same product as 'Mushroom Shiitake Dried [1kg]' (22918987, $0.03125/g = $31.25/kg), but carries no pack and a '1 can @ $25.00' cost. Two records for one ingredient means two different dish costs depending on which the chef picks.
flags.suggested_fix: Merge into 'Mushroom Shiitake Dried [1kg]' and retire this one from the picker.

flags.name: Jasmine Rice
flags.issue: DUPLICATE — same $0.0021/g as 'Rice Jasmine Fragrant [20kg]' (22893550). Two names, one rice.
flags.suggested_fix: Merge into 'Rice Jasmine Fragrant [20kg]'; keep the naming convention (noun first).

flags.name: Chicken Thigh Flt S/Off [Kg]
flags.issue: DUPLICATE — identical cost ($0.0163/g) to 'Chicken Thigh Flt S/Off RSPCA [kg]' (22893557). Likely the same purchase with and without the RSPCA label.
flags.suggested_fix: Confirm with the chef whether these are genuinely two products; if not, merge and keep the RSPCA name.

flags.name: Davidson Plum Puree
flags.issue: COST/PACK — '1 can @ $0.0510'. Five cents cannot be a can of Davidson plum puree; the figure looks like a per-gram or per-mL cost with no pack size attached.
flags.suggested_fix: COULD NOT CONFIRM — cost book only. Needs the pack size; if $0.051/g then a 1kg tub is $51, which is plausible for native plum puree.

flags.name: Potato Starch
flags.issue: PACK — no pack size in the name and pack_unit 'can' @ $5.00. Cannot cost a recipe that uses grams of it.
flags.suggested_fix: COULD NOT CONFIRM — add the pack weight (commonly 500g or 1kg) and set the unit to g.

flags.name: chives
flags.issue: NAME — lowercase and with no unit tag, against the convention every other item follows ('Shallot [Bunch]', 'Carrot [kg]'). Priced per bunch at $1.70, which is plausible.
flags.suggested_fix: Rename to 'Chives [bunch]'. Cosmetic — cost is fine.

flags.name: Fz Barramundi - Fillets
flags.issue: PACK (already surfaced, needs_pack_review=true) — invoiced 1 CTN @ $88.40 (6718182) with no carton weight, so no cost per kg can be derived. Name and price are both fine.
flags.suggested_fix: Chef to state the carton weight. Mentioned for completeness, not a defect.

flags.name: Carrot Large; Coleslaw; Grapefruit Pink Peeled; Tomatoes Roma
flags.code: CLKG Kilogram, KITCSKG Kilogram, KITGPINPEA Each, TR10BX Box
flags.issue: SUPPLIER_CODE — the unit word is being appended to the code, so 'CLKG' is stored as 'CLKG Kilogram' and 'TR10BX' as 'TR10BX Box'. Costs and names are correct; the codes will not match FFT's catalogue on the next lookup.
flags.suggested_fix: Strip a trailing unit word (Kilogram / Each / Box / Bunch / Punnet) from the FFT supplier_code field.
